freezer noun

modern

M-O Silva, through Helfer/Eichenseer

arca gelātōria

Other words

  • capsa frīgorifica

    also used · modern · Traupman 123

    The word of the libellī.

Examples

  • Banānās dēcorticātās in arcam gelātōriam pōne.

    Put the peeled bananas in the freezer.composed

  • būtȳrum ē capsā frīgorificā prōmptum et frustātim concīsum

    butter taken out of the freezer and cut into piecesLibellus IV, Diēs Grātulātiōnis

See also refrigerator, freeze, chest, dishwasher, ice tray, cool box, in pieces.
